'''Minrath''' was a village on the continent of [[Alanciar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. [[Edell Vrai]] and [[Quarra Thayn]] passed through it on their way to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sus'mintri]] during the [[Invasion of Alanciar]].
